text:
sara: Hey team — opening intake for minnow-4b onboarding. Goal: host + dedicated + private test matrix, evaluate int8/int4 quant vs fp16 baseline. Need canary plan, smoke probes, rollback gates, KV cache warmup, and cost targets. Rough target: P95 <= 120ms hosted, MRR within -1% of fp16, cost < $0.0009/token. Thoughts?

dilip: Can you share current fp16 baseline numbers (P50/P95/throughput) and the eval suites you'll run? Also define the hallucination metric we gate on.

emily: baseline (last perf run): P50 45ms, P95 110ms for 512 tokens, throughput 185 rps on 8x-A10 config. Eval MRR 0.842 on QA harness, hallucination ~0.9% on our fact-check suite. Uploading artifacts to /artifacts/minnow4b/fp16/2024-10-31.

manu: For quant experiments propose grid: fp16 -> int8 -> int4 (with kernel fallback). Small batch: 1k sampled prompts across convo/summarize/codegen domains -> collect latency, perplexity, MRR, hallucination, and token-error metrics. Also measure KV cache hit pattern and warmup cost.

ashley: Canary rollout proposal:
- 0.5% traffic, 1h smoke (sanity: errors, latency, basic eval)
- 2% traffic, 3h soak (monitor quality drift)
- 10% traffic, 6h soak (wider surface)
- 50% traffic, 24h soak -> full ramp if green
Fallbacks: auto-fail to minnow4b-fp16; if severe regression (>2% absolute MRR drop OR hallucination >2x baseline) then fallback to raven-13b-compat and pause rollout.

ryan: Dedicated notes: reserve 2 pods initially for canary (ensures isolation), configure autoscale with latency SLO 150ms, and add routing policy to prefer cheaper variant when overall cluster load >80%. Also include per-customer routing tag for tiered fallbacks.

qa-bot: smoke run summary (2024-11-02T10:00Z): int8 -> MRR 0.839 (-0.35%), P95 105ms; int4 -> MRR 0.820 (-2.6%), P95 95ms. Hallucination measured: int8 1.1%, int4 1.8% (↑). Synthetic throughput stable. Full logs: https://internal/ci/1234 (artifact id 1234).

sara: Good early signal. Need domain breakdown (multi-turn QA vs single-turn) and structured evals (summarization, codegen) before canary beyond 0.5%. Also we must add KV pre-warm to avoid cold-cache spikes. Manu, can you add a pre-warm job?

manu: Yep. I'll add a pre-warm job to the canary pipeline. Sketch: ```python
# prewarm kv cache job
for p in sampled_prompts:
    resp = requests.post(url, json={"model": "minnow4b-quant", "prompt": p})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
``` Schedule to run 30m before traffic shift. Will also add latency tracing tags.

ashley: Monitoring + alerts to implement before canary:
- error_rate > 0.5% -> immediate rollback
- P95 increase > 20% relative -> pause rollout and notify oncall
- MRR drop > 1% for 30m window -> rollback
- hallucination rate > 2x baseline -> rollback
Tag traces with `minnow4b-canary` and create per-route dashboards.

deploy-bot: deploy trigger queued: minnow4b-quant-canary -> started at 2048001500. CI stage: perf-harness, smoke-evals, prewarm executed.

sara: Next steps / owners: emily run extended evals overnight (multi-domain), manu add warmup + perf harness tweaks, ashley prep dashboards + alerting, ryan confirm dedicated pool sizing and autoscale policy. Reconvene 09:30 UTC tomorrow. :thumbsup: 

dilip: Also capture per-route tokenization cost delta — some customers have many short prompts which change batching efficiency. Include cost delta per 1M tokens.

sara: Noted, filing ticket INF-7123 and assigning owners. We'll keep the thread for status updates. Thanks all.
